newsitem.title: UK: Libya raises most July term crude formulas 5 cts.
newsitem.headline: Libya raises most July term crude formulas 5 cts.

text.p: Libya's National Oil Company (NOC) raised most term crude contract price formulas for July liftings by five cents, oil traders said.
Es Sider for July will be priced at dated Brent -30 cents, five cents up from June.
But prices for premier grades Brega and Zuetina were cut by five cents to dated Brent +25 cents and by 10 cents to dated Brent +15 cents respectively.

Sirtica was raised five cents to dated Brent -15 cents, Amna was up five to Brent -65 cents, Sarir was up five cents to Brent -60 cents and Bu Attifel was lifted by the same amount to Brent -30 cents.
Offshore Bouri was left unchanged for the second month running at Iranian Heavy -35 cents fob Sidi Kreir.
